old: Commander, we lost them. The swarm tore through every ship in the convoy.
new: They're gone. The swarm tore through every ship in the convoy.

old: Commander. We made it, barely. The convoy is gone, and this world is all we have left.
new: We made it, Commander. Barely. The convoy is gone, and this world is all we have left.

old: Commander, this world is ours now. Give our capital a name worthy of an empire, then tap Save.
new: This world is ours now. Give our capital a name worthy of an empire, then tap Save.

old: Commander, never attack blind. Fleet Command just sent us four Espionage Probes. I've marked a weak Hive garrison near us: tap Espionage on its card and send the probes.
new: Rule one out here: never attack blind. Fleet Command just sent us four Espionage Probes. I've marked a weak Hive garrison near us: tap Espionage on its card and send the probes.

old: Commander, now we know what's waiting there. Send the fighters at that garrison and show Vael'Khor we bite back.
new: Now we know what's waiting there. Send the fighters at that garrison and show Vael'Khor we bite back.

old: Commander, next goal: a second world. Astrophysics decides how many planets we can hold, and it needs Research Center Lv.3, Espionage Technology Lv.4 and Impulse Drive Lv.3. Start with the Research Center.
new: Next goal: a second world. Astrophysics decides how many planets we can hold, and it needs Research Center Lv.3, Espionage Technology Lv.4 and Impulse Drive Lv.3. Start with the Research Center.

old: Commander, everything is in place. Start Astrophysics under Advanced Research: it charts stable orbits for settlers.
new: The pieces are in place. Start Astrophysics under Advanced Research: it charts stable orbits for settlers.

old: Never attack blind. Espionage Probes fly in, count the defenders and come home with a report. They need Shipyard Lv.3 and Espionage Technology Lv.2.
new: Scout before you strike. Espionage Probes slip in, count the defenders and bring back a report. They need Shipyard Lv.3 and Espionage Technology Lv.2.

old: Commander, clean work. That garrison won't trouble us for a while.
new: Clean work. That garrison won't trouble us for a while.

old: Commander, scouts found Hive breeding grounds along the event rim. Leviathans guard them.
new: Our scouts found Hive breeding grounds along the event rim, and Leviathans guard them.

old: Commander, before we claim a second world, our first one has to run properly. Our extractors are starved for power: Structures shows a red Power shortage card. Rule one of a strong economy: power first. Take the Solar Array to Lv.5.
new: Before we reach for a second world, our first one has to run properly. Our extractors are starved for power: Structures shows a red Power shortage card. Rule one of a strong economy: power first. Take the Solar Array to Lv.5.
where: Economy · Upgrade the Solar Array to Lv.5

old: Commander, a rich world draws raiders. A Radar Station spots enemy fleets on their way to us, earlier with every level. Build it under Facility. From now on, every world we hold gets the same order: power, metal, crystal, gas, storage, radar.
new: A rich world draws raiders. A Radar Station spots enemy fleets on their way to us, and every level spots them sooner. Build it under Facility.

old: Commander, that's our homeworld balanced. Keep this order on every world we settle: power, metal, crystal, gas, storage, radar.
new: That's our homeworld in balance. Use the same order on every world we settle: power, metal, crystal, gas, storage, radar.

old: Our flagship is commissioned, Commander. It leads every fleet now, earns experience in every fight, and the Flagship Dock forges its gear.
new: Our flagship is commissioned, Commander. It leads every fleet from today, and every battle it comes through makes it stronger.

old: Commander, that's the Academy finished. From here, missions keep coming with my briefings, but you lead the way: no more pointers, and no more free speed-ups.
new: That's the Academy finished. Missions will keep coming with my briefings, but from here you set the course: no more pointers, and no more free speed-ups.

old: Commander, that's the Academy finished. Our flagship leads the fleet now: it earns experience in every fight, and the Flagship Dock forges its gear.
new: Training's over, Commander. The flagship leads our fleet now, and the Dock will keep forging it better gear.

old: Commander, that's a Void Shark: a cruiser-sized predator with laser turrets bolted to its hide. Bring heavy hulls, and it drops Exotic Tissue for the forge.
new: That's a Void Shark: a cruiser-sized predator with laser turrets bolted to its hide. Bring heavy hulls; it drops Exotic Tissue for the forge.

old: Commander, Nebula Squids are fast, many-armed and hunt in packs. Bring Cruisers and armour. They drop Exotic Tissue, and sometimes Void Essence.
new: Nebula Squids hunt in packs: fast, many-armed and venomous. Bring Cruisers and armour. They drop Exotic Tissue, and sometimes Void Essence.

old: Commander, a Star Leviathan. Its jaws can split a battleship, so scout it first and send our heaviest fleet. It guards rare flagship materials.
new: A Star Leviathan, Commander. Its jaws can split a battleship, so scout it first and send our heaviest fleet. It guards rare flagship materials.

old: Commander, a derelict pyramid station. Send an expedition to open its vault for shards, resources and rare items. From level 3, something guards the halls.
new: A derelict pyramid station. Send an expedition to crack its vault for shards, resources and rare items. From level 3, something still guards the halls.

old: Commander, this Cube is a fortress, and one fleet rarely breaks it, so call a joint strike with our allies. Cubes drop Cube Fragments and Void Essence, the rarest materials in the forge.
new: This Cube is a fortress, and one fleet rarely breaks it, so call a joint strike with our allies. Cubes drop Cube Fragments and Void Essence, the rarest materials in the forge.

old: Commander, the Super Cube is the prize of the galaxy. From Friday to Sunday, alliances fight to seize and hold it. Every minute our alliance holds it earns glory and rewards for every member.
new: The Super Cube is the prize of the galaxy. From Friday to Sunday, alliances fight to seize it and hold it, and every minute ours holds it earns glory and rewards for every member.

old: You've built a balanced homeworld, won your first battles and can now hold a second world. From here, Missions carry on with my briefings, but you lead the way.
new: A balanced homeworld, our first victories, and room for a second world. You're ready, Commander. The missions carry on from here, with my briefings, but you lead.

old: Every mission done: a second world taken from the Hive, pirates raided and our flagship in command. The galaxy is yours to take.
new: Every mission done: a second world taken from the Hive, pirates raided and our flagship in command. Now the real war begins.

old: Our flagship leads every fleet from now on. It gains experience in every fight and wears the gear the Dock forges.
new: Every fleet we send now flies behind our flagship. Keep it fighting, and keep the Dock forging.

old: Welcome back, Commander! Your Academy is right where you left it, and Fleet Command sent supplies to get you moving again.
new: Good to have you back, Commander. The Academy is right where you left it, and Fleet Command sent supplies to get us moving.

old: Welcome back, Commander! Your missions are right where you left them, and Fleet Command sent supplies to get you moving again.
new: Welcome back, Commander. Your missions are waiting where you left them, and there are fresh supplies from Fleet Command.

old: Scanning the Pyramid Overlord. Beware the sigil beam on its face, the stomp of its front legs, and the surge from the beam beneath it.
new: Scanning the Pyramid Overlord. Watch the sigil on its face, the stomp of its front legs, and the beam that surges beneath it.

old: Scanning the Orbital Devourer. Beware its snapping claws, the tentacle lash, and the vortex beam when its maw opens.
new: Scanning the Orbital Devourer. Mind the snapping claws and the tentacle lash, and when its maw opens, the vortex beam.

old: Scanning the Void Warden. Beware the void pulse when its crescents clench, the core beam, and its satellite storm.
new: Scanning the Void Warden. When its crescents clench, a void pulse follows. Then comes the core beam, and its satellite storm.

old: Scanning an Energy Conduit. Beware the discharge when its rings spin up. It feeds the Overlord's shield.
new: An Energy Conduit. When its rings spin up, expect a discharge. This is what feeds the Overlord's shield.

old: Commander, the Battle for the Super Cube has begun! The Cube is emerging from deep space. Rally our alliance and get ready to seize it.
new: Commander, the Battle for the Super Cube has begun! The Cube is emerging from deep space. Rally the alliance and get ready to seize it.

old: Commander, the siege of the Super Cube is on! Alliances are attacking it right now. Join the battle, or watch it live.
new: The siege of the Super Cube is on! Alliances are hitting it right now. Join the battle, or watch it unfold.

old: Commander, the final two hours of the Cube battle have begun. Every minute we hold it counts now.
new: Two hours left in the Cube battle. From here on, every minute we hold it counts.

old: Commander, the Battle for the Super Cube is over. Let's see who was crowned.
new: The Battle for the Super Cube is over. Let's see who wears the crown.

old: Commander, Galaxy War has begun! For three days, every battle point we earn counts toward milestones and rank rewards.
new: Galaxy War has begun! For three days, every battle point we earn counts toward milestones and rank rewards.

old: Commander, the Pyramid Overlord is under attack right now! Watch the fight live.
new: The Pyramid Overlord is under attack! Want to watch the fight?

old: Commander, someone is fighting the Orbital Devourer right now! Watch it live.
new: Someone has taken on the Orbital Devourer. The battle is live right now.

old: Commander, the Void Warden is under attack right now! Watch it live.
new: A fleet is hammering the Void Warden as we speak. Watch it live.

old: Commander, an Energy Conduit is under attack right now! Watch it live.
new: An Energy Conduit is under fire. Take a look, Commander.

old: Commander, an Energy Conduit has fallen! The Pyramid Overlord's shield is weakening.
new: An Energy Conduit has fallen! The Overlord's shield is weakening.

old: Commander, the Overlord's shield is down! Every fleet now hits it at full strength. This is our moment.
new: The Overlord's shield is down! Every fleet hits it at full strength now. This is our moment, Commander.

old: Commander, the Pyramid Overlord has fallen! If our fleets hurt it, our share of the spoils is waiting.
new: The Pyramid Overlord has fallen! If our fleets drew blood, our share of the spoils is waiting.

old: Commander, the Orbital Devourer has fallen! If our fleets hurt it, our share of the spoils is waiting.
new: The Orbital Devourer is finished, Commander. Any damage we dealt earns us a cut of the spoils.

old: Commander, the Void Warden has fallen! If our fleets hurt it, our share of the spoils is waiting.
new: The Void Warden has gone dark for good. Check the spoils: every fleet that hurt it gets a share.

old: Scanning the Brood Matriarch. Beware the hatching swarm from her egg sac, her acid spray, and the slam of her scythes.
new: Scanning the Brood Matriarch. Her egg sac spawns a swarm, she sprays acid, and her scythes can slam down at any moment.

old: Scanning the Iron Tyrant. Beware its broadside, the boarding claw, and the mines in its wake. The engine at its stern runs hot.
new: Scanning the Iron Tyrant: broadsides, a boarding claw, and mines in its wake. The engine at its stern runs hot, and that's our opening.

old: Scanning the Event Horizon Wyrm. Beware the gravity coil, the lens beam, and its tail sweep. Watch for the glowing segments: that's where it can be hurt.
new: Scanning the Event Horizon Wyrm. Gravity coil, lens beam, tail sweep. Watch for the glowing segments: that's where it can be hurt.

old: Scanning the Shard Colossus. Beware the crystal rain, the prism beam, and the shatter. Its heart is exposed for a moment after it breaks apart.
new: Scanning the Shard Colossus. Crystal rain, a prism beam, and the shatter. When it breaks apart, its heart lies exposed for a moment.

old: Commander, the Wednesday titans have arrived! The Brood Matriarch, the Iron Tyrant, the Event Horizon Wyrm and the Shard Colossus are loose on the map. The Titan Hunt is on in Events.
new: The Wednesday titans have arrived! The Brood Matriarch, the Iron Tyrant, the Event Horizon Wyrm and the Shard Colossus are loose, and the Titan Hunt is on in Events.

old: Commander, the Brood Matriarch is under attack right now! Watch it live.
new: The Brood Matriarch is under attack right now. Watch it live.

old: Commander, someone is fighting the Iron Tyrant right now! Watch it live.
new: A fleet has engaged the Iron Tyrant, and those broadsides are worth seeing.

old: Commander, the Event Horizon Wyrm is under attack right now! Watch it live.
new: A fleet is taking on the Event Horizon Wyrm right now. Want to see it?

old: Commander, the Shard Colossus is under attack right now! Watch it live.
new: The Shard Colossus is under fire, Commander. Watch the crystals fly.

old: Commander, the Brood Matriarch has fallen! Everyone who fought her can claim the spoils.
new: The Brood Matriarch is dead! Her swarm is leaderless, and everyone who fought her can claim the spoils.

old: Commander, the Iron Tyrant has been sunk! Its vault is open, and everyone who fought it can claim the spoils.
new: We've sunk the Iron Tyrant! Its vault is open, and every fleet that fought it gets a share.

old: Commander, the Event Horizon Wyrm is destroyed! Everyone who fought it can claim the spoils.
new: The Event Horizon Wyrm is destroyed! If our fleets took part, the spoils are ours to claim.

old: Commander, the Shard Colossus has shattered for good! Everyone who fought it can claim the spoils.
new: The Shard Colossus has shattered for good, Commander. Its bounty is waiting for everyone who fought it.

old: Commander, this is the Pyramid Overlord, a walking pyramid fortress that hunts the middle layers beside its station. Four Energy Conduits feed its shield. Destroy them first, and it takes our full fire.
new: This is the Pyramid Overlord, a walking pyramid fortress that hunts the middle layers beside its station. Four Energy Conduits feed its shield. Destroy them first, and it takes our full fire.

old: Commander, the Orbital Devourer is a world-eater that never stops moving. It roams the whole galaxy on its own path, hunting just above the worlds. Catch it where it is, and strike with our heaviest ships.
new: The Orbital Devourer is a world-eater that never stops moving. It roams the whole galaxy on its own path, skimming just above the worlds. Catch it where it is, and hit it with our heaviest ships.

old: Commander, this Energy Conduit is one of four crystal pylons feeding the Overlord's shield. Bring all four down, and the Overlord takes full damage.
new: One of four crystal pylons feeding the Overlord's shield. Bring all four down, and the Overlord takes full damage.

old: Commander, the Brood Matriarch is the Hive's queen. She nests in the Far Reach, and the worlds around her turn green as her infection spreads. Her swarm rebuilds while she's left alone, so keep up the attack.
new: The Brood Matriarch, the Hive's queen. She nests in the Far Reach, and the worlds around her turn green as her infection spreads. Her swarm rebuilds whenever she's left alone, so keep the pressure on.

old: Commander, the Iron Tyrant is a pirate super-dreadnought patched together from stolen hulls. It sails from hideout to hideout, and its vault fills the longer it sails. The later we hit it, the richer the bounty.
new: Meet the Iron Tyrant: a pirate super-dreadnought patched together from stolen hulls. It sails from hideout to hideout, and its vault fills the longer it sails. The later we strike, the richer the bounty.

old: Commander, the Event Horizon Wyrm is a serpent of black-hole rings, coiled around the black hole at the centre of the galaxy. Only its glowing segments can be hurt, so strike while they're exposed.
new: The Event Horizon Wyrm, a serpent of dark rings coiled around the black hole at the heart of the galaxy. Only its glowing segments can be hurt, so strike while they're exposed.

old: Commander, the Shard Colossus is a crystal golem grown out of the crystal fields. Badly hurt, it shatters into fragments that shield it, but it pays Void Shards in bulk.
new: The Shard Colossus, a crystal golem grown out of the crystal fields. Badly hurt, it shatters into fragments that shield it, but it pays Void Shards in bulk.

old: Commander, an iron asteroid field. Its rocks are veined with glowing ore, and it's our best source of metal, and of Reinforced Alloy for the forge. Send Haulers to mine it, and keep watch: a rival can attack whoever holds the field.
new: An iron asteroid field. Its rocks are veined with glowing ore, and it's our best source of metal, and of Reinforced Alloy for the forge. Send Haulers to mine it, and keep watch: a rival can attack whoever holds the field.

old: Commander, a crystal comet. Its icy core bristles with crystal, so this is where we mine crystal, and Quantum Crystal for the forge. Send Haulers, and hold it until their holds are full.
new: A crystal comet. Its icy core bristles with crystal, so this is where we mine crystal, and Quantum Crystal for the forge. Send Haulers, and hold it until their holds are full.

old: Commander, a gas cloud. Our Haulers skim it for gas, the fuel every fleet burns in flight. It yields slowly, so send plenty of Haulers and keep them safe.
new: A gas cloud. Our Haulers skim it for gas, the fuel every fleet burns in flight. It yields slowly, so send plenty of Haulers and keep them safe.

old: Scanning Glacius. Beware its frost nova, the ice lances from its orbs, and absolute zero when its rings spin up.
new: Scanning Glacius. Frost nova, ice lances from its orbs, and absolute zero once its rings spin up.

old: Scanning Ignis. Beware the solar flare from its horns, the magma rain, and the inferno when its core blazes.
new: Scanning Ignis now. Solar flares from its horns, magma rain, and an inferno when its core blazes.

old: Scanning Voltaris. Beware chain lightning, the ion storm that strips our shields, and the thunderclap of its crescents.
new: Voltaris on scan. Chain lightning, an ion storm that strips our shields, and the thunderclap of its crescents.

old: Scanning Verdanth. Beware the thorn volley, the spore bloom, and the overgrowth when its beam surges.
new: Scanning Verdanth. Thorn volleys, spore blooms, and overgrowth whenever its beam surges.

old: Commander, this is the Pentarch, every surviving Elemental fused into one, tearing at the black hole at the centre of the galaxy. It is the greatest threat we have faced. Rally every fleet and every ally.
new: This is the Pentarch: every surviving Elemental fused into one, tearing at the black hole at the heart of the galaxy. Nothing we've faced comes close. Rally every fleet and every ally.

old: Commander, the Pentarch has fallen! The Void is saved, and everyone who fought it can claim the spoils.
new: The Pentarch has fallen, Commander! The Void is safe again. Go and claim what we've earned.

old: Commander, our alliance has seized the Super Cube! Every minute we hold it earns glory. Reinforce the garrison before the others strike back.
new: Our alliance has seized the Super Cube! Every minute we hold it earns glory, so reinforce the garrison before the others strike back.

old: Commander, we have lost the Super Cube! Another alliance has taken it from us. Rally our allies and take it back.
new: We've lost the Super Cube. Another alliance has taken it, so rally our allies and take it back.

old: Commander, our alliance has been crowned the holder of the Super Cube! Claim your rewards on the Events page.
new: Our alliance has been crowned holder of the Super Cube! Claim your rewards on the Events page.

old: Commander, the Elementals are gathering at the Void. The Convergence begins in ten minutes. Watch it, or strike now while they are apart.
new: The Elementals are gathering at the Void. The Convergence begins in ten minutes: watch it, or strike now while they're still apart.

old: Commander, a Clean Sweep! All five Elementals fell before the fusion, and the Convergence never formed. Everyone who fought them can claim the spoils.
new: A Clean Sweep, Commander! All five Elementals fell before the fusion, and the Convergence never formed. Claim the spoils.

old: Commander, the Pentarch's core has shattered! Its shards are raining across the galaxy. Gather them before they fade.
new: The Pentarch's core has shattered! Its shards are raining across the galaxy. Gather them before they fade.

old: Commander, the Cube sits on the Void, and every alliance in the galaxy is closing in.
new: The Cube sits on the Void, and every alliance in the galaxy is closing in.

old: Tap any world to spy on it, attack it, send it cargo, or add it to your favourites. The galaxy is yours to take, Commander.
new: Tap any world to spy on it, attack it, send it cargo, or add it to your favourites. Where we go next is your call, Commander.

old: The survivors have reached the Void and fused. The Pentarch is tearing at the black hole. Rally every fleet, Commander!
new: The survivors have reached the Void and fused. The Pentarch is tearing at the black hole. Everything we have, Commander: now!
